tools.name: search_tools
tools.description: Search the Seventh Feed directory of AI marketing, SEO, GEO/AEO, writing, cold email outreach, social scheduling and growth tools. Every word in q must appear in the name, domain, summary, category or tags. Filter by category id (see list_categories) or agent_ready.

tools.name: get_tool
tools.description: One marketing or SEO tool by domain: our summary, the site’s own title and description (with date checked), pricing and free tier where stated, agent-readiness (llms.txt, MCP registry id, public API), traffic and revenue with source and date, operational risk notes if any, our referral code if we ha

tools.name: list_categories
tools.description: The categories used to sort AI marketing and SEO tools, with how many tools each has.

tools.name: list_new_tools
tools.description: Tools by the date Seventh Feed first saw them, newest first. Pass since (YYYY-MM-DD) to get only those first seen on or after that day.

tools.name: compare_tools
tools.description: The same facts as get_tool for 2 to 5 tools side by side.

tools.name: list_referrals
tools.description: Seventh Feed’s own referral codes and partner offers for AI marketing and SEO tools: what a new user gets, the link or code, the terms and the date checked.

tools.name: submit_tool
tools.description: Suggest an AI marketing, SEO, GEO, writing, outreach or growth tool for the directory by its URL or domain. Queued and listed if the site has a title, description or llms.txt.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: search_tools, list_new_tools, list_referrals · Public sink: search_tools, submit_tool.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: search_tools, list_new_tools, list_referrals · Public sink: search_tools, submit_tool

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
